name: media-toolkit
description: Browser-first media toolkit with a TypeScript/Express fallback server (images, video, audio, fonts, PDF, documents, spreadsheets)

scripts.build: npm --prefix web run build && npm run build:server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p server/tsconfig.contracts.json && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p server/tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
